overview_description.description:
Kodda is a Mexican startup that allows people to have a healthy lifestyle in the long term. It believes that habits are the root of the problem and we seek to encourage people to start effortlessly creating them so that it is sustainable in the long term.

It was founded in 2020 and is located in Monterrey, Nuevo Leon.
